submitted.rationale: Index 19 (Co0.34Sb0.66) is at the CoSb2O6 trirutile composition, which MACE puts on the hull (Ehull 0). It gave the only positive EQE (0.0124%) of the three merit measurements.

rejected.reason: Co-rich spinel region (Co7Sb2O12). Measured EQE was -0.0059%, which is no photoresponse.
Sb-rich side of CoSb2O6. Measured EQE was -0.0090%, which is no photoresponse.

consultations.verdict: Support: MACE puts trirutile CoSb2O6 on the hull (Ehull 0), so the phase-pure film near Co 0.33 (index 19) is plausible. MEGNet HSE gap 0.37 eV is likely underestimated for correlated Co d-states, so it is uninformative about absorption at 2.1 eV.

Mild support: MACE puts the Co7Sb2O12 inverse spinel close to the hull (0.03 eV/atom), so it probably forms near Co 0.78 (index 6). Its earlier MEGNet gap (1.44 eV) is below 2.1 eV, so it should absorb. This contrasts with the Sb-rich end, which measured low.

Uninformative to mild support. The Sb-rich side (CoSb2O6 plus Sb oxide) gave the only positive EQE so far. The MEGNet gap for Co-Sb-O phases is below 2.1 eV, so they should absorb. The GP UCB points to index 23, on the Sb-rich side of the CoSb2O6 composition.
